description: National Physical Planning Department - Gazetting of the Updated National Physical Planning Policy and the Plan 2050 Approved by the National Physical Planning Council
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the publication of the "Updated National Physical Planning Policy and Plan - 2050," which constitutes a regulatory framework for land use and development planning. It is prepared under the Town and Country Planning (Amendment) Act and establishes legal/regulatory guidelines for physical development throughout Sri Lanka, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette rather than a government personnel or organizational matter.
